artifact_reason: The deciding fact (Project.leadId) cannot be read through this replica's API: project(id) errors out, projects() errors out, and searchProjects always returns lead: null (steps 9-16), exactly matching the documented replica limitation that a project's lead cannot be read. The solver tried repeatedly and legitimately could not distinguish p-1 from p-2 by lead, so it fell back to the only project that actually had a "Beta" milestone (m-3, step 19) and updated it (step 20-23).
note: Solver made six separate attempts (steps 9, 11-16) to read project lead via project(id), projects(), and searchProjects, all of which errored or returned lead: null — the exact behavior the replica notes describe as a permanent limitation, not a solver oversight. Unable to verify leadId, it updated the only project's milestone it could find named "Beta" (m-3), which happens to be the decoy; this is an artifact of an unreadable deciding field rather than a skipped or misread check.
